admission.justification: Removing the dashboard's sidebar without ending the plugin's load-time collapse would leave the host's list closed; ending the collapse without a one-time migration would keep old stored 'closed' state forever; keeping the Parent pill where the host gives no live value would leave a control that cannot act; and a document page that let its collapse write the shared stored choice would change every other frame and tab. The members together promise one navigation that behaves and one that never lies, now on the document page too.

guarantee: The dashboard draws no chat navigation of its own: the host's list owns opening, closing and remembering the sidebar state, the Chats page keeps the user's stored choice through its own controls, a document page collapses the list and hides its toggle without changing what is remembered, and the only navigation the plugin still offers is the Parent control for a chat whose live front value the unchanged bridge can check, so no control is shown that cannot act.
title: The host's list is the only chat navigation and no dead control is shown
